Fixes #50860

## Why this is not a duplicate
Checked `gh pr list --state open --search "50860 in:body"` and issue keywords
"resumable session encoder memory" — no open PR addresses this. The issue has
no assignee and no comments.

## Summary
`Scheduler._free_encoder_inputs` already frees the scheduler/encoder-cache
reference for committed multimodal inputs, but the raw input tensors
(`MultiModalFeatureSpec.data`) stay attached to the request. For resumable
(realtime) sessions, which keep one `Request` alive for the whole stream and
append a new `MultiModalFeatureSpec` per frame via `_update_request_as_session`,
the data for every committed frame is retained until the session ends.

This change nulls `mm_feature.data` at the same point the encoder input is
freed, gated on `request.resumable` so non-session requests are unaffected.
`MultiModalFeatureSpec.data` is documented as "Can be `None` if the item is
cached" (`vllm/multimodal/inputs.py`), and by the time the input is freed its
encoder output is already committed to the decoder KV cache, so the raw
tensors are never read again.

## Model evaluation
No model weights or output-affecting code path is touched; the change only
releases already-committed input tensors. The original reporter measured
1021 MiB engine-core host RSS growth over 4000 frames with this retention.

## Tests
- Added `test_free_encoder_inputs_releases_data_for_resumable_session` in
  `tests/v1/streaming_input/test_scheduler_streaming.py`. It fails without the
  fix (verified by reverting) and passes with it.
- `python -m pytest tests/v1/streaming_input/test_scheduler_streaming.py -q`
  → 9 passed.
- `python -m pytest tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py -q -k "not multimodal"`
  → 102 passed, 34 failed. All 34 failures are pre-existing and environment
  related (missing `mistral_common`/`pydantic` model-inspection deps); the
  failure list is byte-identical with and without this change.
- `ruff check` / `ruff format --check` clean on both changed files.

AI assistance was used in the design and implementation of this change.

detail.body:
Fixes #50860

## Why this is not a duplicate
Checked `gh pr list --state open --search "50860 in:body"` and issue keywords
"resumable session encoder memory" — no open PR addresses this. The issue has
no assignee and no comments.

## Summary
`Scheduler._free_encoder_inputs` already frees the scheduler/encoder-cache
reference for committed multimodal inputs, but the raw input tensors
(`MultiModalFeatureSpec.data`) stay attached to the request. For resumable
(realtime) sessions, which keep one `Request` alive for the whole stream and
append a new `MultiModalFeatureSpec` per frame via `_update_request_as_session`,
the data for every committed frame is retained until the session ends.

This change nulls `mm_feature.data` at the same point the encoder input is
freed, gated on `request.resumable` so non-session requests are unaffected.
`MultiModalFeatureSpec.data` is documented as "Can be `None` if the item is
cached" (`vllm/multimodal/inputs.py`), and by the time the input is freed its
encoder output is already committed to the decoder KV cache, so the raw
tensors are never read again.

## Model evaluation
No model weights or output-affecting code path is touched; the change only
releases already-committed input tensors. The original reporter measured
1021 MiB engine-core host RSS growth over 4000 frames with this retention.

## Tests
- Added `test_free_encoder_inputs_releases_data_for_resumable_session` in
  `tests/v1/streaming_input/test_scheduler_streaming.py`. It fails without the
  fix (verified by reverting) and passes with it.
- `python -m pytest tests/v1/streaming_input/test_scheduler_streaming.py -q`
  → 9 passed.
- `python -m pytest tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py -q -k "not multimodal"`
  → 102 passed, 34 failed. All 34 failures are pre-existing and environment
  related (missing `mistral_common`/`pydantic` model-inspection deps); the
  failure list is byte-identical with and without this change.
- `ruff check` / `ruff format --check` clean on both changed files.

AI assistance was used in the design and implementation of this change.

+    def test_free_encoder_inputs_releases_data_for_resumable_session(self):
+        """Resumable sessions must drop committed encoder input data.
+
+        Resumable sessions accumulate every frame's raw input tensors via
+        _update_request_as_session. Once the encoder output is committed to the
+        decoder KV cache, _free_encoder_inputs should null MultiModalFeatureSpec
+        .data so the session does not retain every frame for its lifetime.

+

+            prompt_token_ids=[1, 2, 3],
+            mm_features=[mm_feature],
+        )
+        # The input at offset 0, length 1 is committed: start_pos + num_tokens
+        # (0 + 1) <= num_computed_tokens (1) - num_output_placeholders (0).
+        session.num_computed_tokens = 1
+
+        scheduler.encoder_cache_manager.request_cached_ids.setdefault(
+            session.request_id, set()
+        ).add(0)
+
+        scheduler._free_encoder_inputs(session)
+
+        assert mm_feature.data is None
+        assert scheduler.encoder_cache_manager.get_cached_input_ids(session) == set()
+

**Call `Scheduler._free_encoder_input` exactly once.**

`Scheduler._free_encoder_input` already calls `encoder_cache_manager.free_encoder_input(...)` and updates `self.ec_connector`. The direct calls at Lines 2374-2375 and 2383-2384 run before the existing wrapper call at Line 2390. Resumable requests therefore free the same cache entry twice. Non-resumable requests skip `self.ec_connector.update_state_after_free(...)`.

Keep these branches as the `freed` decision only. Call `Scheduler._free_encoder_input` once after the resumable data-clear guard.

**Preserve multimodal data when the encoder output can be evicted.**

`_free_encoder_inputs()` sets `MultiModalFeatureSpec.data` to `None` after releasing the encoder-cache reference. If another allocation evicts that encoder output before the resumable request is scheduled again, `_try_schedule_encoder_inputs()` schedules the feature, but `EncoderRunner.prepare_mm_inputs()` skips it because its data is `None`. `gather_mm_embeddings()` then raises `RuntimeError("Encoder cache miss for ...")`.

Retain the raw data, or restore it from a valid multimodal cache, whenever the encoder output is not guaranteed to survive preemption and cache eviction. Add a regression test for release → eviction or preemption → reschedule.
